newsitem.title: USA: GenRad says signs contract with Interro.
newsitem.headline: GenRad says signs contract with Interro.

text.p: GenRad Inc said Tuesday its Advanced Diagnostic Solutions division has signed a distribution agreement with Interro Systems to provide the first dedicated generic OBDII scan tool for use with vehicles that meet U.S. Environmental Protection Agency requirements.
The company said U.S. legislation mandates that new vehicles incorporate On Board Diagnostics (ODB) as part of emission-related on board computer controllers.
GenRad designs, manufactures and sells a line of hand held diagnostic equipment for the automotive technician and the shop.
